# Plugin.Maui.KeepAwake

Keep the screen on (reference-counted acquire / release) for .NET MAUI.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.KeepAwake
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.KeepAwake
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-keep-awake/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Current release

1.0.1. Host apps must declare Android and iOS permissions listed in the README.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.KeepAwake

Registration: `UseKeepAwake` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I keep the MAUI screen on during scan / POS / video?
- FlagKeepScreenOn / idle timer without a WakeLock

## Do not use when

- CPU / partial WakeLock
- OS background work (use Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks)
- Orientation lock (use Plugin.Maui.DeviceOrientationPlus)
